userStories.title: Claim prints Next after success
userStories.description: As an agent, after spine claim I want ## Next (or JSON next/run) so I do not call status again. Market: mutating verbs should return the new ready item.
acceptanceCriteria: After main(['claim']) on an open ticket, stdout includes Answer or set-status resolved
test in tests/test_mutate_next.py (do not rewrite tests/test_next.py)

userStories.title: set-status prints Next after success
userStories.description: As an agent, after a legal set-status I want the next command printed. Same pattern as claim.
acceptanceCriteria: After init, new work-item, set-status doing, stdout includes checking or ## Next

userStories.title: Help lists prime show next
userStories.description: spine --help must name the agent sit-down verbs so a stranger finds them.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/test_help.py asserts prime, show, and next appear in --help

userStories.title: new prints Next after mint
userStories.description: As an agent, after spine new ticket I want ## Next so the next verb is claim.
acceptanceCriteria: After init and main(['new','ticket','--title','X']), stdout includes ## Next and claim

userStories.title: release prints Next after success
userStories.description: Same mutating-verb pattern as claim/set-status.
acceptanceCriteria: Claim a ticket then main(['release', path]) stdout includes ## Next

userStories.title: JSON payload includes ok boolean
userStories.description: As an agent, spine prime JSON should have ok true when doctor messages are all ok/empty so I do not regex messages.
acceptanceCriteria: After init, prime JSON has ok true
After a BROKEN blocker with --report-only, ok is false
userStories.notes: prime JSON ok via doctor_ok(); version on payload

userStories.title: link prints Next after success
userStories.description: Mutating-verb pattern. tests/test_mutate_next.py already has test_link_prints_next if this is done.

Otherwise implement: after spine link A B, stdout includes ## Next
userStories.notes: link already printed ## Next; test_link_prints_next green

userStories.title: status --json includes version
userStories.description: Agents should know CLI version without a second command. Market: beads bd --version in JSON envelopes.
acceptanceCriteria: If tests/test_next.py::test_status_json_includes_version exists and pytest is green, mark passes true
Otherwise add version from spine.__version__ to status_payload

userStories.title: show --json emits frontmatter object
userStories.description: As an agent, I want spine show 01-open-work --json so I can read Status/Owner without parsing YAML. Market: beads bd show --json.
acceptanceCriteria: spine show <stem> --json prints JSON with keys file, meta, body
test in tests/test_show.py (do not rewrite tests/test_next.py)

userStories.title: spine run prints first executable command
userStories.description: As an agent, I want one line I can exec. spine run prints the first status_payload run entry. If run is empty, exit 2 and print the first next line to stderr. Market: beads bd ready then exec.
acceptanceCriteria: After init plus an open ticket, main(['run']) prints a line starting with spine claim and exits 0
After init with empty map only, main(['run']) exits 2
userStories.notes: spine run; placeholders with ... omitted from run; exit 2 when run empty

userStories.title: prime JSON includes inited boolean
userStories.description: As an agent, I want prime.ok and prime.inited so a non-target is obvious without regex on messages. inited is true iff docs/spine/contract.yaml exists.
acceptanceCriteria: After init, prime JSON inited is true
On an empty tmp dir, prime --report-only JSON inited is false
userStories.notes: already landed: tests/test_prime.py inited true/false; cli prime JSON emits inited from contract.yaml exists

userStories.title: run after claim prints set-status
userStories.description: After claiming the open ticket, spine run should print the resolve command, not claim again.
acceptanceCriteria: init, new ticket, claim, then main(['run']) stdout contains set-status and resolved
userStories.notes: already landed: claimed ticket yields Answer+set-status resolved in next_lines, so run[0] is the resolve command. Regression test tests/test_run.py::test_run_after_claim_prints_set_status (exact line + set-status/resolved). 71 passed.

userStories.title: claim --json prints payload not board prose
userStories.description: As an agent, spine claim --json should print status_payload (with run/hitl) instead of ## Next markdown. Market: beads --json on mutations.
acceptanceCriteria: After init + ticket, main(['claim','--json']) stdout is JSON with keys run, next, user
userStories.notes: claim --json flag + status_payload JSON (run/next/user); prose Next kept for non-json. Files: src/spine/cli.py, tests/test_mutate_next.py (test_claim_json_prints_payload). Commit skipped: unrelated dirty tree.

userStories.title: set-status --json prints payload
userStories.description: As an agent, after a legal set-status I want JSON with run/next/user, not ## Next markdown. Same --json dest as other verbs (_add_json_flag on the subparser).
acceptanceCriteria: After init, new work-item, main(['set-status', path, 'doing', '--json']) stdout is JSON with keys run, next, user

userStories.title: release --json prints payload
userStories.description: Mutating-verb --json pattern. spine release <target> --json prints status_payload keys, not ## Next.
acceptanceCriteria: Claim a ticket then main(['release', path, '--json']) stdout is JSON with keys run, next

userStories.title: new --json prints payload
userStories.description: After minting a ticket, agents want JSON next/run (usually claim) instead of the board novel.
acceptanceCriteria: After init, main(['new', 'ticket', '--title', 'X', '--json']) stdout is JSON with keys run, next
userStories.notes: new --json (payload only, no minted path + ## Next); tests/test_mutate_next.py::test_new_json_prints_payload

userStories.title: prime JSON includes cwd
userStories.description: spine prime JSON must include cwd (the process working directory) so agents do not guess. Copy cwd from status_payload; do not drop it when adding ok/inited.
acceptanceCriteria: After init, prime JSON cwd equals str(tmp_path)

userStories.title: link --json prints payload
userStories.description: Last mutating verb. spine link A B --json prints status_payload keys, not ## Next.
acceptanceCriteria: After init and two tickets, main(['link', a, b, '--json']) stdout is JSON with keys run, next
